name: Kitami Tsubomi
source:
Skills: Hide-and-seek
Likes: [url=/c37213]Onii-chan[/url], basking in the sun
Dislikes: Loud things
Wish: "I want to sleep more with Onii-chan and smell his scent."

The youngest daughter of the Kitami family. While she is the quietest one of the bunch, she often does bold actions in order to show her love for Onii-chan, which surpirses her sisters.
